call_purpose: You wanted your custom domain to load your funnel instead of showing a "site can't be reached" error.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you replaced the old records with CNAME records for your domain and its www version, and you confirmed that both now load your funnel.

covered.text: We explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.

support_next_steps.text: We will check that the secure certificate has been issued, and message you if it has not.
